sentence: From 2022-02-09 to 2026-11-10 (239 weekly decisions, both traded at the open), labels set with the pre-market price returned +45.4% a year (worst drawdown -33.1%) against +41.6% (-39.4%) for labels set at the previous close; the two agreed on 89% of stock-weeks.
